parameters.name: ConnectSubType
parameters.description:
The subtype of the connection. Valid values:

- **vpc2vpc**: Express Connect.

- **vpcpeer**: peering connection.

parameters.name: FirewallSwitchStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

- **opened**: The firewall is enabled.

- **closed**: The firewall is disabled.

- **notconfigured**: The firewall is not configured.

- **configured**: The firewall is configured.

> If you do not specify this parameter, VPC firewalls in all states are queried.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the member account.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Default value: **10**. Maximum value: **50**.

parameters.name: PeerUid
parameters.description: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the peer VPC belongs.

parameters.name: RegionNo
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPC.

> For more information about the regions where Cloud Firewall is supported, see [Supported regions](~~195657~~).

parameters.name: VpcFirewallId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPC firewall.

parameters.name: VpcFirewallName
parameters.description: The instance name of the VPC firewall.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPC.
